title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Foundation Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, requirement-home trace tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene for the DoQ foundation surface.
scope: This verification covers the DoQ foundation package: ALPN `doq`, UDP port 853 default helpers, explicitly supplied alternate DoQ ports, UDP port 53 rejection, RFC 9250 error-code constants, and the two-octet DNS message length-prefix codec. It does not verify complete DNS query/response stream dispatch.
preconditions: The RFC 9250 specification exists as canonical JSON at `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-RFC9250.json`.
DoQ behavior remains in `Incursa.Quic.Dns` rather than in the transport runtime.
expected_result: The focused DoQ foundation tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9250 artifacts, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The DoQ foundation is trace-owned and verified as a constants, option-validation, alternate-port, and message-framing floor. Full RFC 9250 stream lifecycle and interop behavior remains future work.
